papers_reviewed.title: Is Trend Still Your Friend?: A Microstructural Account of the Demise of Short-Term Trend-Following
papers_reviewed.summary: 100 liquid futures 1995-2025; short-term trend P&L collapsed on small-tick (electronified) contracts post-2009 but remains intact on large-tick ones. HFT market-making withdrawal is the mechanism. Validates OB filter approach and monthly ETF rotation pipeline.

papers_reviewed.title: Fast Numbers, Slow Language: Bridging Quantitative and Qualitative Earnings Signals
papers_reviewed.summary: EarningsInOne corpus S&P 1500 2022-2025. Quantitative EPS surprise arbed away in minutes; qualitative transcript signals peak T+1 and remain tradeable. Directly validates H174 T+1 entry timing. Q&A credibility is an untapped signal layer (H391 candidate).

papers_reviewed.title: End-to-End Parametric Portfolio Policies for Cross-Asset Futures Timing
papers_reviewed.summary: E2E differentiable Sharpe on 16 CME futures. Transformer > LSTM at lower turnover after costs; matches or beats equal-weight. Validates DeePM approach independently. Directly applicable to H026 ETF rotation as lightweight H392 candidate.

papers_reviewed.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers_reviewed.summary: Systematic review 77 LLM trading studies through March 2026. Reproducibility crisis: only 2/19 qualifying studies have time-consistent splits, 1/19 has transaction cost model. 0/19 achieve R3 reproducibility. Validates Alpha Illusion checklist (H389).

papers_reviewed.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading
papers_reviewed.summary: Chinese A-share specific. Mask-first design for price-limit contamination. 213-factor GPU engine, Sharpe 2.05 synthetic / 1.63 A-shares. US equity relevance limited — price limits don't apply. Technique of 'mask contract' is transferable to any survivorship bias check.
papers_reviewed.note: A-share specific, not staged. The mask-first technique is a general backtesting discipline already covered in survivorship-bias.md

papers_reviewed.title: Agentic Trading systematic review: architecture taxonomy
papers_reviewed.summary: Proposes Architecture-Capability-Adaptation lens for LLM trading agents. Not a validated framework, but useful scaffold for categorizing H274/H381/H382/H383/H384.

papers_reviewed.title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models
papers_reviewed.summary: Evaluates Chronos/TimesFM/Moirai on realized volatility forecasting. Not reviewed in depth today — already have ts-foundation-models.md. Queue for future expansion if vol forecasting becomes production need.
papers_reviewed.note: Low priority given existing ts-foundation-models.md coverage
